text:
After playing only 31 games last season, Matthew Tkachuk is back and passing like it's his whole job. He has 26 points in 18 games, 22 of them assists, 16 of them on the power play, and he's on a four-game point streak built entirely on helpers (six of them).

This isn't only a power-play story. Florida takes 57% of the 5v5 expected goals with him on the ice, 8.2 points better than without him. What's missing is his own shot: four goals on 4.8 expected, 10% shooting against a talent range centred near 13%, and fewer chances of his own (0.84 expected goals per 60, down from 1.49 last season). A few more goals should come; a 25-goal pace probably needs more shots.

He's also sharing a dressing room with brother Brady now, and our style comparisons list Brady among Matthew's closest matches. HockeyFeed asked whether Brian Burke publicly called out both brothers this week. Florida has lost two straight to Washington and Boston, and Matthew had four assists across them.
headline: Matthew Tkachuk, back as a full-time playmaker
